about_the_game:
A Fairy Tale Exploration Journey
Each level is a whimsical adventure through fantastical storybook worlds. Our signature thick-painted hand-drawn art style makes every frame wallpaper-worthy - the game's true visual hallmark. Complemented by custom-crafted background music for each environment, this creates an immersive atmosphere that fully draws you into the experience.

Game Content

10 unique storybook worlds + 1 secret chapter、30+ interactive NPC characters、1,200 collectible items to discover

✦ Gameplay Features ✦

1. Main Quest
Progress through the narrative by collecting yarn balls hidden across environments to unlock the game's true ending.

2. Side Quests
Help vibrant NPC characters by completing their item collection requests in different scenes.

3. Secret Chapter

Unlock Postcard Mode by collecting canned food during main story progression, then gather Cat Collars from treasure chests in this mode to access bonus challenges and uncover hidden storylines! (Psst... exclusive secret narrative included!)

4. Artistic Discovery
Explore richly textured painterly landscapes filled with classic IP-inspired Easter eggs and visual surprises.

The game supports the following languages:
Simplified Chinese,Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese - Brazil, and German.

short_description: Embark on a leisurely journey through a kitten's eyes, where the world blossoms into a realm of magical whimsy. Whisker Wanderlust is here! Help the mischievous kitten (who just shredded their human's 376th yarn ball) collect treasures from distant lands♥
